issue.title: Muse remaining async tools (workflow, cron_*, subagent_*, snooze_reminder): add a run.toolset allowlist only if telemetry shows wait usage
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-177.4 (epic sase-177; plan "Follow-ups" item 5). After sase-177,
Muse's shell is synchronous, but `muse exec` still exposes other async tools: `workflow`,
`cron_*`, `subagent_*`, and `snooze_reminder`. Any of them could be used to "wait"
across the single turn, which nothing will deliver.

Conditional work: first check telemetry (Muse tool-call records under agent artifacts,
and wait_guard_log.jsonl firings from the new Muse stranded-wait guard) for these tools
being used to wait. Only if they are, add a per-invocation `run.toolset` allowlist to
`muse exec` in MuseProvider.invoke that removes them. If telemetry shows no such use,
close this as not needed with the evidence.
